evidence.quote: A VideoCardz source confirmed that one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand, but Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips.
evidence.one_line: Unnamed VideoCardz source says Nvidia allegedly told a board partner that RTX 50 Super launch is on hold over 3GB GDDR7 chip prices, though the partner already has units.
evidence.speaker: VideoCardz source (unnamed)

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025 as the memory chip crisis unfolded.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia stopped supplying VRAM chips with GPU dies to board partners in late 2025, forcing partners to source memory themselves.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter)

evidence.quote: these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants
evidence.one_line: Report says 3GB GDDR7 chips cost two to three times the price of 2GB variants used in Super cards with 18GB or 24GB VRAM.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter), citing the publication

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: SK hynix

evidence.quote: the company not announcing a new GPU at CES 2026
evidence.one_line: Nvidia announced no new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years it had skipped a new GPU at the show.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter)

evidence.quote: Its latest AI systems are now more expensive than ever, with memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%.
evidence.one_line: Unattributed report says memory is 25% of the bill of materials for Nvidia's latest AI systems, with costs up nearly 500%.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (reporter), unattributed

rungs.condition: No RTX 50 Super GPU is publicly launched by 2027-01-31
